title: Key Modifiers: Handling Keyboard Events
description: React to specific keys with .enter, .esc, and custom key aliases.

slides.title: Listening for Specific Keys
slides.content:
# Key Modifiers

When listening for keyboard events (`keydown`, `keyup`), you often need to react only when a specific key is pressed. Vue provides **key modifiers** for this.

```html
<input @keyup.enter="submit" />
```

This calls `submit` only when the **Enter** key is released.

slides.title: Common Key Modifiers
slides.content:
Vue aliases for common keys:

- `.enter`
- `.tab`
- `.delete` (captures both Delete and Backspace)
- `.esc`
- `.space`
- `.up`
- `.down`
- `.left`
- `.right`

You can also use any valid key name via **kebab-case**: `.page-down`, `.arrow-up`, etc.

slides.content: A search box that triggers when Enter is pressed:
slides.codeSnippet:

slides.title: System Modifier Keys
slides.content:
You can also combine with system modifier keys:

- `.ctrl`
- `.alt`
- `.shift`
- `.meta` (Cmd on Mac, Windows key on Windows)

```html
<input @keyup.ctrl.enter="save" />
```

This triggers only when **Ctrl + Enter** is pressed.

quizData.question: Which modifier would you use to trigger a method only when the Enter key is pressed?
quizData.explanation: `.enter` is the built‑in key modifier for the Enter key.
